verdict.rationale: Multiple sources confirm BYO-LLM/API-key support: GitHub lists 'Use with any LLM' and 'Bring your own model', and pricing docs explicitly state both Open Source and Cloud plans support bringing your own LLM keys, with pay-as-you-go no-markup model access as an alternative. missing for 10: no independent/hands-on verification of setting arbitrary API keys or a full list of supported providers.
